# Attention Mechanisms in Transformers

Attention mechanisms allow each token in a sequence to compute a weighted combination of all other tokens' representations, with weights determined by the similarity (via dot-product) between query and key vectors. This enables the model to dynamically focus on relevant parts of the input, allowing distant tokens to directly influence each other regardless of their position in the sequence.

Attention mechanisms in transformers enable the model to focus on specific parts of the input sequence that are most relevant to understanding the context of a particular word. By computing attention scores, the model dynamically weighs the importance of different input elements, allowing for a more nuanced and context-aware representation of the data.
